input.question: When was Phi Delta Gamma founded?

documents.text: Phi Delta Gamma (professional) Phi Delta Gamma (ΦΔΓ) was a professional fraternity in the field of Forensics. Phi Delta Gamma was founded on June 7, 1924 at the University of Iowa at Georgetown University School of Law. Founders were William O. Moore and George 6. Hurley, State University of Iowa; Kenneth E. Oberholtzer, University of Illinois; Dean William A. Hamilton, College of William and Mary; Russell D. Tubaugh, Ohio University; Paul A. Lomax, University of Southern California; William Waldo Girdner, George Washington University; and Carl E. Anderson, University of Minnesota. It was a founding member of the Professional Interfraternity Conference
